description: This file defines interface declarations for the cm agent web configuration API, including function prototypes for handling web configuration data, encoding/decoding, resource management, and version control, tailored for a cloud or embedded device management system.

methods.name: WebConfig_blob_handler
methods.description: Handles the encoded web configuration blob data, likely processing, validating or extracting information.

methods.name: get_base64_decodedbuffer
methods.description: Decodes a base64 encoded string into a binary buffer, returning its size.

methods.name: cmagentdocDestroy
methods.description: Deallocates or cleans up a cmagent document structure.

methods.name: webConfigFrameworkInit
methods.description: Initializes the web configuration framework modules or context.

methods.name: get_msgpack_unpack_status
methods.description: Checks and returns the status of a msgpack unpack operation.

methods.name: processcmagentWebConfigRequest
methods.description: Processes an incoming web configuration request, returning an error structure if needed.

methods.name: freeResourcesCmagent
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the cmagent, used during cleanup or error handling.

methods.name: rollbackcmagentFailureConf
methods.description: Performs a rollback of configuration changes in case of failure.

methods.name: getcmagentBlobVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version number of the cmagent configuration blob.

methods.name: setcmagentBlobVersion
methods.description: Sets or updates the version number of the cmagent configuration blob.
